Why Builders Choose Us

Salient Features & Advantages

Seismic strength isn't an add-on — it's built into every Smart Panel. Tested and certified for fire, thermal, sound, and impact resistance.

Seismic Safety & Resilience

A lighter wall means significantly less force hits the structure during seismic events — ensuring lower base shear, minimal deflection, and maximum earthquake safety.

Speed & Lower Cost

Tongue-and-groove interlocking panels click into place fast, dramatically cutting construction labor time, saving money, and bringing project handover forward.

Certified & Approved

Listed on the Government District Rate List — verified and straightforward to specify on public infrastructure, commercial developments, and private homes alike.

Green Construction

Zero topsoil dug up and no kiln smoke released. Engineered eco-friendly materials built in part from recycled glass fiber and non-hazardous bonding agents.

Thermal Resistant & Insulation

EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5mm calcium silicate boards keeps interiors naturally cooler in summer and warmer in winter, cutting energy bills significantly.

Fire Proof Time Limit (≥3-4 Hours)

Engineered fire-retardant calcium silicate skins and non-combustible core provide a certified 3 to 4-hour fire rating, exceeding international safety standards.

Sound Insulation (≥35-45 dB)

High sound damping capacity (≥35 to ≥45 dB) absorbs external noise, making it ideal for quiet residences, schools, hospitals, and conference spaces.

Space & Cost Saving

Slimmer panel profiles increase carpet area by up to 5-8%, while ultra-light density trims structural steel and foundation costs by 5-6%.

Water & Moisture Resistant

Non-asbestos calcium silicate boards on both faces prevent water seepage, moisture buildup, mold, and seasonal dampness across Nepal's climate.

Our Story & Leadership

The Smart Way to Build in Nepal

We started in 2024 with a simple goal: help Nepal build better. A year later, our plant in Bharatpur, Chitwan came online, backed by an NPR 20 crore investment. Today it turns out 150,000 sq. ft. of Smart Panel a year — lightweight, insulated, and ready for sites across the country.

"Smart, eco-friendly, earthquake-ready building material so every community can build faster, safer, and for less."

— Bimal Raj Gosai, CEO (Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.)

Sandwich Panel

Smart Sandwich Panel

Sizes: 50mm, 75mm, 100mm, 120mm × 2400/2700/3000mm × 610mm

Lightweight interlocking prefabricated panels with an EPS-cement core and 4.5mm calcium silicate board on both faces. Available in 50mm, 75mm, 100mm, 120mm thickness (Lengths: 2400/2700/3000mm, Width: 610mm). Fire-rated, thermal-insulated, and earthquake-ready.

Solid Panel

Smart Solid Panel

Sizes: 50mm, 75mm, 100mm, 120mm × 2400/2700/3000mm × 610mm

Lightweight interlocking prefabricated panels made from EPS beads, cement, sand, and bonding agents, reinforced with internal mesh for superior impact strength. Plastered on both sides after installation. Available in 50mm, 75mm, 100mm, and 120mm.

EPS Block

Smart EPS Block

Sizes: 100×200×600mm, 150×200×600mm, 200×200×600mm

Lightweight construction blocks made from expanded EPS beads, OPC cement, water, and specialized additives. Highly thermal-efficient, weather-durable, and available in multiple sizes: 100×200×600mm, 150×200×600mm, and 200×200×600mm.

Rapid Assembly

On-Site Installation with 5 Familiar Tools

No heavy cranes or long learning curve. A standard Smart Panel crew gets to work immediately with five familiar job-site tools.

01

Cutting Machine

Trims panels cleanly to exact dimensions on site with zero debris.

02

Drill Machine

Sets steel fixings and structure anchors quickly and securely.

03

Welding Machine

Secures the galvanized steel framing and structural connection joints.

04

Thread Hand Drill

Used for fine adjustments, electrical conduit pass-throughs, and finishing.

05

Plumb Bob

Ensures every interlocking panel wall is true, plumb, and perfectly vertical.
